title: Reconstruction / Redevelopment of Dilapidated Unsafe Tenanted Buildings (Suburbs / Non-Cessed in City)
scope: Reconstruction/redevelopment of authorized tenant-occupied buildings that have been declared unsafe/uninhabitable by MCGM. Applies to buildings in Suburbs & Extended Suburbs, AND authorized non-cessed tenant-occupied buildings in Mumbai City (Island City).
trigger_condition: Building declared unsafe for human habitation OR to be demolished under lawful MCGM order — duly certified as such.

eligibility.existence_evidence: Certified inspection extract of MCGM for 1995-96 OR Court Order proving existence prior to 13/6/1996

rehab_tenement_carpet.max_note: Above 70 sqm the tenant pays cost of construction per Ready Reckoner rate. Excess carpet counted for rehab FSI only, NOT incentive FSI.
rehab_tenement_carpet.non_residential_formula: Equal to area occupied in old building

composite_tenant_plus_non_tenanted.total_fsi: rehab_fsi + 50% incentive_fsi + FSI already authorisedly consumed by non-tenanted buildings

fsi_formula.opt_out_option: If rehab + incentive < permissible FSI per Reg 30, owner may opt for regular development up to permissible FSI via TDR / additional-FSI-on-premium (Reg 30)

excluded: Land under reservation of public amenities

fungible_compensatory_on_rehab.restriction: Cannot be used for free-sale component; must add area over eligible entitlement to existing tenants

additional_development_cess.applies_to: BUA over-and-above permissible FSI per Table 12 (Reg 30)

transit_arrangement.permission: Temporary transit camps on same land or land elsewhere belonging to landlord, with concessions as in Reg 33(10) SRS
transit_arrangement.demolition_deadline: Within 1 month from OC of reconstructed building

corpus_fund.created_by: Landlord or Co-op Housing Society of tenants

extraction_gaps.calculator_status: PENDING — needs a reference 33(7)(A) feasibility to validate the FSI + incentive formula and dev cess escalation before authoring Reg33_7A_Calculator.php
